monospace.usage: Use strictly for IP addresses, domain names, hashes, DNS records, and technical telemetry.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: The 'Control Room' Grid - High density, strict grid lines, optimized for data scanning.
spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use flat solid backgrounds with sharp 1px borders. Avoid soft shadows. Expose the structural skeleton of the dashboard.

buttons.style: Flat, sharp edges (rounded-sm), high contrast. Primary actions use Cyan or White.
buttons.classes: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-xs px-6 py-3

cards.style: Flat background, 1px border. No shadows. Optional 'Tracing Beam' effect for critical risk cards.

tables.style: Dense tabular layout. Use monospace for data columns. Explicit left-alignment. Crisp row borders.

badges.style: Used for Severity/Risk scores. Outline style preferred or highly opaque backgrounds with crisp borders.
badges.classes: px-2 py-0.5 border text-xs font-mono rounded-sm uppercase

stepper.style: Live scan progress. Use vertical or horizontal connected nodes. Active node pulses cyan.
stepper.classes: flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center font-mono text-xs

motion.interactions: Minimal and crisp. Focus on micro-interactions for data loading.
motion.loading: Use monospace ASCII spinners or matrix-style rapid text decoding effects for the live scanning phase.

icons.style: Sharp, technical icons. Use Shield, Globe, Server, Terminal, Lock, AlertTriangle.

images.description: Black and blue abstract squares/rectangles. Use as a very low opacity (10-20%) background in the initial Landing/Scan trigger page behind the main domain input, combined with a vignette or radial gradient mask to fade it into the black background.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA compliance. Ensure critical/red badges have sufficient contrast against dark background. Use text-shadow on overlapping elements.
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, inputs, buttons, and risk score outputs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI (.js files, not .tsx).
Start by updating tailwind.config.js and index.css with the deep dark theme colors (zinc-950 background, zinc-900 surfaces).
Integrate 'IBM Plex Sans' and 'JetBrains Mono' via Google Fonts in index.html.
The Landing Page should feature a massive, centrally aligned domain input field with monospace typography, toggles below it, and the background image layered behind a heavy black gradient.
The Live Scan Progress view should feel like a terminal - lots of rapid status updates, glowing active steps, and monospace logs.
The Scan Result Page must be a 'Control Room' grid layout. Heavily utilize Shadcn tables for Live Hosts, IP Intelligence, and Tech Fingerprints. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all IPs, domains, and hashes.
Risk Score should be prominent, using the severity colors (Low=Green, Medium=Yellow, High=Orange, Critical=Red). Use hard 1px borders around severity badges.
Do NOT use soft rounding (no rounded-xl or rounded-full for structural elements). Keep it sharp with 'rounded-sm' or 'rounded-none'.
Ensure dark mode is forced or set as default.
